title: D2 DLQ failure-metadata spec
description: Schema for contracts/dlq-failure-metadata/dlq-failure-metadata.spec.json — the source-of-truth catalog of (a) JSON property-name constants for the DlqFailureMetadata record and (b) closed-enum string values for the failure-cause taxonomy. D2.Shared.Messaging.DlqMetadata.SourceGen dispatches multi-target: the fields catalog emits DlqFailureMetadataFields into D2.Shared.Messaging.Abstractions; the causes catalog emits DlqFailureCauses into D2.Shared.Messaging.RabbitMq. tools/ts-codegen emits both into @d2/messaging-abstractions.

fields.description: Property-name constants for the DlqFailureMetadata record.

constName.description: Public C# / TS constant identifier — UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Must be unique across the fields catalog.

value.description: Wire-format JSON property name. Must be unique across the fields catalog.

constName.description: Public C# / TS constant identifier — UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Must be unique across the causes catalog.

value.description: Wire-format cause string. Must be unique across the causes catalog.
